venueText.title: Gold Acres
venueText.shortDescription: A grand open-air venue with expansive lawn space, a covered lounge block, guest rooms, and reliable event infrastructure.
venueText.overview: Gold Acres is built for large-format celebrations, pairing a lush 60,000 sq. ft. lawn with covered support spaces, guest rooms, parking, and venue services that make high-footfall events feel organized from arrival to wrap-up.

sections.title: Facilities
items: Approximately 60,000 sq. ft. open area with lush green lawn.
Approximately 5,800 sq. ft. covered area including a 1,000 sq. ft. AC lounge.
2 guest rooms with adequate washrooms.
Spacious kitchen and parking facility.

sections.title: Illumination
items: Existing lights in the hall, kitchen, washrooms, driveway, parking area, and working ground lights are included within the package.

sections.title: Vendors
items: Empanelled decorators, florists, and electricians support venue setup requirements.

sections.title: Other Services
items: Power supply for basic illumination.
Valet parking with public address system.
Security system with CCTV.
Fire fighting system.
Pest control.

venueText.title: The Maple
venueText.shortDescription: A landscaped lawn venue with fountain features, a banquet hall, guest rooms, and event-ready furniture support.
venueText.overview: The Maple balances outdoor freshness with banquet convenience, pairing a large lawn and rockery setting with an AC hall, guest rooms, kitchen access, and in-package event essentials for flexible celebration formats.

sections.title: Facilities
items: Approximately 33,000 sq. ft. open area with lush green lawn.
Colourful fountain and rockery.
Approximately 2,300 sq. ft. AC banquet hall.
2 guest rooms with adequate washrooms.
Spacious kitchen and large parking facility.

sections.title: Illumination
items: Existing lights in the hall, kitchen, washrooms, driveway, parking area, and working ground lights are included within the package.

sections.title: Decoration
items: Fixed numbers of sofa sets, banquet chairs, buffet counters, and related setup pieces are included within the package.

sections.title: Vendors
items: Empanelled decorators, florists, and electricians take care of client requirements.

sections.title: Other Services
items: Power supply for basic illumination.
Valet parking with public address system.
Security system with CCTV.
Fire fighting system.
Pest control.

venueText.title: The Tulip
venueText.shortDescription: A hilltop venue with a banquet hall, food arena, open celebration space, kitchen access, and parking.
venueText.overview: The Tulip brings together a large air-conditioned hall, a dedicated food arena, and open-air celebration space in one hilltop venue, making it a strong fit for weddings, receptions, and event formats that move between indoor and outdoor settings.

sections.title: Location
items: A hilltop venue within the PC Chandra Garden campus.
Designed for celebrations that benefit from indoor comfort and open-air spillover space.

sections.title: Facilities
items: Approximately 6,000 sq. ft. AC banquet hall.
Approximately 3,000 sq. ft. AC food arena.
Approximately 5,500 sq. ft. open area.
Kitchen access and large parking facility.

sections.title: Illumination
items: Existing venue illumination is included to support smooth event operations across indoor and outdoor zones.

sections.title: Event Use
items: Suitable for weddings, receptions, festive evenings, and high-guest-count social events.

venueText.title: The Meadows
venueText.shortDescription: A hillock-top venue overlooking the E. M. Bypass with a banquet hall, food arena, lawn, and backup-ready event infrastructure.
venueText.overview: The Meadows sits on a green rise overlooking the E. M. Bypass and Science City, combining a modern AC banquet hall, food arena, lawn, and backup-supported operations for events that need both setting and reliability.

sections.title: Location
items: Situated on a hillock overlooking the E. M. Bypass and Science City.
Surrounded by lush greenery.

sections.title: Facilities
items: Approximately 4,500 sq. ft. AC banquet hall with modern facilities.
Room with attached washroom.
Approximately 1,700 sq. ft. AC food arena.
Approximately 2,000 sq. ft. lawn.
Spacious kitchen and parking facility.

sections.title: Illumination
items: Existing lights in the halls, lawn, kitchen, washrooms, pathway, driveway, and parking area are included within the package.

sections.title: Decoration
items: Fixed numbers of sofa sets, banquet chairs, buffet counters, and related setup pieces are provided within the package.

sections.title: Vendors & Caterers
items: Empanelled decorators, florists, and electricians support venue requirements.
Clients may choose from empanelled caterers serving vegetarian and non-vegetarian cuisines.

sections.title: Other Services
items: Adequate power supply for existing facilities plus back-up generator.
Valet parking with public address system.
Security system with CCTV.
Fire fighting system.
Pest control.
